title: signal
description: One reading from something the app senses (camera, mic, UI). The id comes from signal-catalog.json. 'slider' signals carry a value from 0 to 1 that changes continuously. 'moment' signals fire when something happens (state 'start') and may report when it stops (state 'end'), so a held gesture can arm other commands with only_while.

id.description: Dotted id from the signal catalog, e.g. vision.hand.right.height or audio.clap.

raw.description: The same reading in the signal's own units (see the catalog), e.g. MIDI pitch for audio.hum.pitch.

state.description: For moments: 'start' when it happens, 'end' when a held gesture is released.
